rows.exactSourceSentence: The magazine felt like a mirror and a mood board rolled into one.
rows.sourceMeaning: Something that reflects identity and inspires taste at once; paired object metaphors.
rows.expression: a mirror and a mood board rolled into one
rows.senseComparison: The magazine is both an identity-reflecting mirror and an inspiration board; owner 1181 teaches two roles or qualities combined in one thing. This is the same combination decision. Owner 1904 concerns a social-media frame for self-image only and does not capture the two-function combination.
rows.requiredOwnerWork: Add the optional-all passive pairing “X and Y rolled into one” with a bounded two-component detector branch. Explicitly assess one no-all pairing without changing question/key IDs, keep the old all-rolled and active forms, and align Chinese. Attach book10-16-1371 exact source provenance. Do not copy the mirror/mood-board source as a learner model.

rows.exactSourceSentence: Every powerful tool casts a shadow when used carelessly.
rows.sourceMeaning: Major benefits may have harmful side effects; a shadow metaphor.
rows.expression: every powerful tool casts a shadow
rows.senseComparison: Owner 1841 casts a shadow over a whole experience, meaning a concern makes that experience less positive; this source warns that a powerful tool can have harmful effects when misused. Owner 2513 requires a lasting negative effect (“long shadow”), absent here. Owner 781 is commercial reach, not harm. No safe same-sense owner detector match.
rows.specificBlocker: The source omits the usual over/on complement and uses a broad, bespoke aphorism. Broadening 1841 to bare “casts a shadow” would conflate spoiled experience, durable consequence, and tool-misuse harms. A separate seven-step target is not yet shown to have a distinct bounded learner decision.
rows.duplicateRelation: Earliest occurrence of the exact repeated sentence; later 3740 remains attached to this unresolved owner decision.
